# Qwen resolution held-out photographs

Eight fresh Commons photographs, selected without inference. Source metadata, exact bytes, hashes and author/license links are in sources.json; original Commons API responses are retained per query. Transformations are changed versions under the same source license and attribution, recorded in transformations.json. No photo is cropped. Prior Hidden Data source titles and hashes are excluded.

The frozen scoring plan is docs/phase-03/evidence/qwen/resolution/heldout-plan.json. External independent human review remains pending. Assistant pre-inference notes, if present, are not human scores or complete ground truth. No qualification PASS may be inferred from these fixtures.
